data.title: 2B · 废弃游乐园城堡的机械烟火
data.description: 长满爬山虎的废弃哥特式游乐园城堡尖顶平台上，夜空不断爆开机械生命体发射的五彩缤纷节日烟火。2B 身穿浅蓝白蕾丝的清凉战斗装束，单手扶着栏杆仰望夜空。眼罩下的面容微仰，火光将她雪白的肌肤与轻柔的裙纱染上梦幻般的彩光，在这怪诞而孤独的世界中呈现出震撼人心的纯净之美。
data.location: 废弃游乐园古堡观景平台
data.action: 单手扶栏杆仰望满天机械烟火，清凉战斗服随风扬起，微仰下颌若有所思
data.lighting: 盛大璀璨烟花在夜空中爆裂的多色艳丽光晕与古堡暗色剪影
data.camera: three quarter view, low angle, medium shot
data.promptProse: Standing on an ivy-draped balcony atop the abandoned gothic amusement park castle in her ice-blue floral lace combat leotard, 2B rests one hand along the weathered stone railing and tilts her chin upward. Brilliant bursts of multicolored fireworks bloom across the dark night sky above the ruined spires, painting shifting crimson, gold, and cyan reflections across her pale lace and poised features. Viewed from a slightly low three-quarter angle, the festive explosions glow starkly behind the dark castle silhouette.
data.animaCaption: Resting one hand on the ivy-covered castle railing in her ice-blue lace leotard, 2B tilts her head up toward multicolored fireworks bursting across the night sky. Shifting colored light washes over her face and lace against the dark ruined amusement park towers.
